cards.name: RESEARCH REVIEW — Prioritise v2 and verify integrations
cards.description:
Research review dated 22 September 2026. All original master sections have been assessed through 30 separate capability areas using official product/help/technical sources.

The detailed findings, R01–R30 requirements, source URLs and acceptance outcomes are stored directly on the master card, checklist 15:
https://trello.com/c/pZDaXXal

This is a decision/discovery card, not a claim that any feature is built. Preserve the original concept and distinguish research proposals from accepted MVP scope. No vendor purchase or API compatibility is implied.

Main recommendation: build KSS-specific shared records and workflow; integrate existing specialist training, payroll/accounting and operational systems where practical. Prioritise complete onboarding/self-service and operational-to-finance chains over many disconnected screens.

New/strengthened proposals include leave/offboarding; staff/client request queues; approved commercial variations; current-version briefings; fresh audit evidence; linked corrective actions; kit/key custody; handover; integration-health visibility; controlled offline capture. Welfare/SOS needs a separate safety assessment.

Use the checklist to settle the first build scope, dependencies and proof required. Each R section on the master also has its own next action and acceptance test. Do not mark implementation complete from research alone.

limits: Read-only; research proposals are not implementation approval; hosted gates remain open.
